subject: Confidential: Associate Manager reassignment for Eng-Platform
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Confidential: Associate Manager reassignment for Eng-Platform

Team —

I need to start a confidential coordination thread about a short-term manager reassignment for Ethan Park (Eng - Platform). Marissa, as discussed off-thread, you'll be on parental leave starting 12/01. To avoid disruption in the performance review cadence and ongoing roadmap work, I propose Vivek step in as Ethan's interim manager for the next 10 weeks.

Key asks:
- Vivek: can you take interim ownership of 1:1s and performance checkpoints starting 12/01?
- Neha/Monica (HR): what approvals do we need for a temporary reporting change >60 days that may affect review timelines?
- Marissa: please confirm you are comfortable with this arrangement and whether there are any talent-development notes we should share with Vivek.

I have attached a draft manager transfer form and a one-page handover checklist. This is confidential until we have HR and executive sign-off.

[Attachment: manager_transfer_form.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: handover_checklist.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thanks —
David
David Kim
Head of Engineering (Platform)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Associate Manager reassignment for Eng-Platform

David —

I support this. Ethan and I have already started a partial handoff: current projects, active PRs, and the onboarding plan for the infra initiative. I'll prepare a short write-up (2 pages) with context on his current goals and calibration notes for the upcoming review.

Two items for consideration:
- Ethan has a mid-cycle growth plan goal tied to ownership metrics; if the formal reviewer changes, we should document continuity so it doesn't reset his goals.
- I recommend a shadow 1:1 between Vivek and Ethan during the last two weeks of Nov so Vivek can meet stakeholders.

Happy to draft the write-up and approve the transfer form once HR confirms process.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Associate Manager reassignment for Eng-Platform

Thanks — this is helpful context. HR checklist and ask list below:

1) Written acknowledgement from the employee (Ethan) consenting to temporary reporting change.
2) Completed transfer form (signed by current manager, interim manager, and yourself, David).
3) Clarify timeline: start date 2026-12-01 and expected review date owner for the Dec/Jan cycle.
4) If the reassignment extends beyond 90 days, we need Director (Laura) approval for any change that might alter compensation/review cadence.
5) Payroll note if any changes to org code are needed.

I created a DocuSign envelope for the transfer form; I can add the signers once you confirm the list. Please do not share beyond this thread (HR and leadership only).

DocuSign (preview): https://redwood.app/docusign/1234-approve

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 14:33:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Confidential: Associate Manager reassignment for Eng-Platform — request for exec clearance

Monica / Laura —

Forwarding the thread. Requesting executive clearance for Vivek to act as interim manager for Ethan Park starting 12/01 through the end of Q1 (approx 12 weeks). HR flagged that anything >90 days needs exec sign-off because it could affect review ownership and calibration.

Proposed mitigation: maintain Marissa as the formal reviewer for calibration notes (documented) while Vivek does day-to-day management and provides a written review input at the Jan cycle. If the reassignment needs to extend past Q1, we will re-evaluate and follow formal transfer protocols.

Attachments: handover checklist (draft)

Thanks —
David
(On behalf of Eng leadership)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Associate Manager reassignment for Eng-Platform

David / Marissa —

I can take the interim manager role. Proposed immediate steps:
- Week of 11/29: shadow 1:1 with Marissa + intro meeting with key stakeholders (SRE, infra, product).
- 12/01: Vivek takes ownership of weekly 1:1s and backlog priorities.
- 12/10: joint calibration note from Marissa and Vivek to HR before the review cutoff.

I'll run a 30/60/90 plan with Ethan and share the handover doc by 11/28.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Associate Manager reassignment for Eng-Platform — APPROVED (exec clearance)

David —

Approved for interim reassignment through 2027-03-31 with the following conditions:
1) HR obtains Ethan's written acknowledgement and the transfer form is signed by all parties via DocuSign.
2) Marissa remains listed as the primary reviewer for calibration notes; Vivek files the performance input by 12/10.
3) If the reassignment is extended beyond 2027-03-31, return to Exec for approval prior to extension.

Neha/Monica: please coordinate payroll/org-code notes and mark the personnel record. Once signed, please circulate the signed-approval PDF to this thread.

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
